# id with Form Elements

#### Course: Learn HTML

## id with Form Elements

Remember this code to create a form.

```html
1<form action="/html-form-submit" method="post" target="_blank">
2    <label>Email: </label>
3    <input type="text" name="account_email"><br>
4    <input type="submit">
5</form>
```

Here, we can use the id attribute (along with for) to associate each form input with its corresponding label.

For example,

```html
1<form action="/html-form-submit" method="post" target="_blank">
2    <label for="email">Email: </label>
3    <input type="text" id="email" name="email">
4    <input type="submit">
5</form>
```

Here, id="email" and for="email" associates the <input type="text"..> with the label Email:.

In this case, when a user focuses on the input field, a screen reader will indicate that the field is for entering the email.

This is really helpful for users who rely on assistive technologies like screen readers.
